description:
Recording of a river on the Rorota Trail in Rémire-Montjoly, French Guiana.
The water flows about 2 metres from the microphones, with occasional low wind and the surrounding forest in the distance.

Recorder MixPre6 II
ORTF Setup: 2 x CCM4 Schoeps Microphones in a Cinela windscreen
Original Recording in Wave, 96kHz, 24bit
GPS 4.879459, -52.253435
REF: GUY-260122-07
Date: 22 January 2026

Recorded during a residency at Guyane Art Factory, Cayenne, French Guiana, in January 2026.
name: River Ambience on the Rorota Trail - Rémire-Montjoly, French Guiana
